hits.title: Tempus to Acquire Personalis for $1.5B | GenomeWeb
hits.snippet: NEW YORK – Tempus AI said on Monday that it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Personalis, expanding the Chicago-based precision medicine company's minimal residual disease (MRD) testing capabilities. ... Under the terms of the agreement, Personalis shareholders will receive $16.25 per share of common stock, representing an approximately 6 percent premium to Personalis' closing share price on Friday for a total enterprise value of approximately $1.5 billion. Tempus' existing ownership interest in Personalis was approximately $200 million, giving the deal a total value of about $1.7 billion. The transaction is all-stock, although Tempus has the option to pay up to half of the total consideration in cash. ... The boards of both companies approved the transaction, which is expected to close late this year or early next, subject to Personalis' shareholder approval and receipt of applicable regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.
